commit_message: Implement ADR 0123 stateful behavior tree runtime
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0123 stateful behavior tree runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements the stateful Behavior Tree runtime core from ADR 0123: prepared immutable execution plans, independent per-runner cursor state, memory Sequence/Selector semantics, bounded step budgets and debug transitions, exact action lifecycle hooks, deterministic abort/reset behavior, generation replacement, source-NodeId snapshots, and a stateful ECS runner adapter.

This is the first implementation slice; follow-up dispatcher requests on the same Draft PR will add the ADR's typed stateful decorators and Play-mode authoring/debug presentation.
